experiences.name: Sagrada Família Guided Tour
experiences.description: Explore Gaudí's iconic unfinished basilica with a skip-the-line guided tour. Marvel at the intricate facades, stunning stained glass windows, and learn about the century-long construction history. Climb the towers for panoramic city views.

experiences.name: Gothic Quarter Walking Tour
experiences.description: Wander through Barcelona's medieval Gothic Quarter, discovering Roman ruins, the Barcelona Cathedral, hidden plazas, and centuries-old architecture. A self-guided or group tour reveals layers of history from Roman Barcino to medieval Barcelona.

experiences.name: La Boqueria Market Food Experience
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in Barcelona's legendary public market on La Rambla. Sample fresh tapas, jamón ibérico, local cheeses, seafood, and fresh-squeezed juices from the vibrant stalls. A true feast for the senses and a cultural institution since 1217.

experiences.name: Park Güell & Gràcia Neighborhood Exploration
experiences.description: Visit Gaudí's whimsical Park Güell with its mosaic terraces, gingerbread gatehouses, and sweeping city views, then descend into the bohemian Gràcia neighborhood for craft cocktails and tapas at local bars frequented by artists and locals.

experiences.name: Barceloneta Beach & El Born Nightlife Circuit
experiences.description: Start with a sunset stroll along Barceloneta Beach, then head into the trendy El Born district for dinner at a pintxos bar, followed by cocktails at rooftop bars and dancing at one of Barcelona's legendary clubs like Pacha or Opium. Experience the city's world-famous nightlife scene.
experiences.location: Barceloneta Beach & El Born district, Barcelona
